methods.name: public static void returnResult(final T result, final AsyncResultCallback<T> callback, @Nullable Handler handler)
methods.comment:
* Calls the {@code callback} to return the {@code result} object. The {@code callback} will be
     * run in the {@code handler}. If the {@code handler} is null, the callback will be called
     * immediately.
     *
     * @param <T> Result type.
